result.reason: The revision does not reliably reach the fallback because subsection (c) still independently requires Garman’s written authorization for any assignment. The margin comment cannot make that operative language subject to subsection (d). In addition, the mutual no-consent affiliate carve-out exceeds the fallback, under which non-successor assignments require consent, and unnecessarily gives Vendor broader assignment rights. Subsection (d) is otherwise professionally drafted and preserves the restrictions on transfers, leases, exports and sublicenses of the Work.
